units.source_text: 名人看到黑69，恍如突然望见岛影。

en.t: When the Master saw Black 69, it was as if he had suddenly glimpsed the shadow of an island.

units.source_text: 他一下子发起呆来，露出一副和蔼可亲的神色。

en.t: He fell into a daze all at once, his face taking on a kindly, approachable expression.

units.source_text: 光是这点，在名人来说也是罕见的。

en.t: That alone was rare for the Master.
